items.title: APH Q2 Deep Dive: AI Datacenter Demand and CommScope Acquisition Propel Growth
items.summary: Electrical connector manufacturer Amphenol (NYSE:APH) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 55% year on year to $8.76 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($9.35 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 7.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.35 per share was 13.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
